title.en: An everyday moment, with several possible meanings
title.zh: 同一时刻，可以有多种含义

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者参加一次普通读书交流后，还想听对方谈论作品，但暂时不想解释这种兴趣。他可以停在“这段谈话让我想继续听”这句描述，或不作记录，不需要再见面来检验。想继续谈、欣赏作品与身份语言是不同问题，这个例子也不推断对方有什么感受或意愿。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader leaves an ordinary book discussion wanting to hear more about the work, without wanting to explain that interest. They can stop at “I wanted to keep listening” or keep no record, without another meeting to test it. Wanting conversation, appreciating a work and identity language are different questions. The example infers no other person’s feelings or wishes.

title.en: An optional observation that can stay private
title.zh: 可以完全不做的私人观察

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“目前愿意描述的只是哪一件事，哪些含义可以先不决定？”可以只针对虚构情境，把已描述的事实、可用语言和未决定事项分开。参与者可以不同意或停止，不解释自己的经历、不提供他人信息，也不以讨论要求形成一个结论。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which single observation is the reader willing to describe, and which meanings can remain undecided?” Use only the fictional situation to distinguish described facts, useful language and undecided matters. Participants may disagree or stop without their own experiences, another person’s information or a required conclusion.

title.en: Limits, privacy and the right to stop
title.zh: 边界、隐私与停止的权利

paragraphs.zh: 补充情境与讨论由费马测试编辑部原创，可只讨论虚构读者，也可以略过；不要求关系经历、联系、亲密实践、身份表达或公开。二十题按连续五组各四题记录，按各题“目前”或“回看”措辞作答，没有统一的固定回顾天数。1完全不符合、2比较不符合、3暂时不确定或说不清、4比较符合、5非常符合，另可选“我不想回答这题”。数字是题文符合程度的回答类别，不是吸引量、频率、能力或身份确定程度；3的不确定只针对该条描述。每题都明确选择后才完成，空白与明确跳过不同。每组保留1、2、3、4、5、跳过六类次数，合计四题；数字回答数是1—5类别次数之和，暂不确定是其中选3的子集，不额外加一次。例如4、3、1、跳过，数字三题，其中一题暂不确定，另有一题跳过，总共四题。没有数值相加形成的得分、均值、百分比、排名、清晰度等级、最接近类型或推荐标签。只要全表有任意数字回答，五主题都显示分布和同一套通用全文；某主题四题全跳过时保留其四次跳过和一般性读法，不推断原因。二十题全部跳过时，不生成个人主题卡或领域解释，只保留一般权利、隐私、安全与退出；五篇公开通用指南始终可独立阅读。五主题分别记录不证明统计独立，不互相推导，也不把选择较多的类别当作更真实或更成熟。原创题本、分类与英文工作译文尚未建立信效度、常模、公平性、语言等价或变化阈值；APA背景资料关于尊重个人语言、不强加标签的原则，不为这些题目提供验证或背书。本页不能确定、证明、改变或压抑取向，不由记录判断身份改变或不变，不询问吸引对象的性别。讨论可以保留未知、不同意或结束，无需展示答卷、私人消息或为某种身份辩护。回答与记录仅在当前页面内存，无草稿、最终结果缓存、逐题上传、分析事件或个人结果分享；刷新、换语、离开、浏览器历史恢复或重测按现有流程清除。此承诺不删除浏览历史，也不能阻止旁人看到屏幕、系统截屏或截图。设备或处境不合适时，可以直接离开，不必完成观察或解释。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored the additional scenes and prompts. Discuss fictional readers only or decline, without relationship experience, contact, intimate practice, identity language or disclosure. Five consecutive four-statement groups follow each item’s current or looking-back wording, with no uniform fixed recall period. Responses are 1 Does not fit at all, 2 Mostly does not fit, 3 Temporarily uncertain or hard to say, 4 Mostly fits and 5 Fits very well, plus explicit preference not to answer. Numbers mark fit with the statement rather than attraction, frequency, ability or identity certainty. Uncertainty at three concerns that particular description. All 20 need an explicit choice to finish; blank differs from a skip. Each topic retains counts at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and skip, totaling four. Numeric count includes categories 1–5; uncertain count is the subset at three, not an extra response. Choices 4, 3, 1 and skip therefore mean three numeric responses including one uncertain, plus one skip: four statements. There is no score from adding values, mean, percentage, ranking, clarity grade, closest type or recommended label. If any numeric response exists anywhere, all five topics show distributions and the same general full guides. A wholly skipped topic retains four skips and general guidance without inferred reasons. If all 20 are skipped, no personal topic cards or domain interpretations appear: only general rights, privacy, safety and exit remain. All five public guides remain independently readable. Separate recording establishes no statistical independence or cross-topic inference, and a more-selected category is no more authentic or mature. Reliability, validity, norms, fairness, language equivalence and meaningful-change thresholds remain unestablished for the original form, grouping and working English. APA background principles about respecting personal language and avoiding imposed labels validate or endorse none of these items. The page cannot determine, prove, change or suppress orientation, decide identity change or stability from a record, or infer a target gender. Discussion may retain unknowns, disagreement or stop, without answers, private messages or defense of an identity. Responses and records stay in current-page memory without drafts, final-result caches, item uploads, analytics or personal-result sharing. Reloading, changing language, leaving, history restoration and retaking follow existing clearing behavior. That promise erases no browser history and prevents no screen observation, operating-system capture or screenshots. Leave if a device or situation is unsuitable, without completing an observation or explaining.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者欣赏一幅画，也喜欢与另一位读者聊创作。他可以分别用“欣赏作品”和“享受谈话”描述，也可以觉得无需拆开；这两种选择都不要求得出约会或身体接触的愿望。分类是否有用由当事人决定，不把能列出更多词当作更成熟，也不要求通过实践证明。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader appreciates a painting and enjoys discussing the process with another reader. They may describe appreciation and conversation separately or see no use in separating them. Neither choice requires a wish to date or have physical contact. The person decides whether distinctions help; listing more terms is no maturity achievement and needs no practical test.

title.zh: 一个可以跳过的小比较

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“这些说法对这一次体验是否有帮助，哪些重叠或暂不适合？”可以只针对虚构情境，把已描述的事实、可用语言和未决定事项分开。参与者可以不同意或停止，不解释自己的经历、不提供他人信息，也不以讨论要求形成一个结论。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Are these descriptions useful for this experience, and which overlap or do not fit for now?” Use only the fictional situation to distinguish described facts, useful language and undecided matters. Participants may disagree or stop without their own experiences, another person’s information or a required conclusion.

title.en: No ability grade or identity conclusion
title.zh: 不评能力，不给身份结论

title.en: A change in context is not a diagnosis

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者两次想起某类谈话，第三次忙于别的事而没留意。他可以只描述记得的差异，保留原因未知，不必补成稳定模式、变动轨迹或隐藏身份。这也不是要求开始追踪日记；没有可用描述时，可以停下，不用重测来证明一致。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader remembers a kind of conversation twice and notices little on a third occasion while occupied elsewhere. They can describe the remembered difference without explaining it as a stable pattern, a trajectory or a hidden identity. No tracking diary is required. If no description is useful, they can stop without retesting to prove consistency.

title.en: An optional note with room for unknowns

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“记得的观察是什么，哪些只是可能解释，是否有必要继续回看？”可以只针对虚构情境，把已描述的事实、可用语言和未决定事项分开。参与者可以不同意或停止，不解释自己的经历、不提供他人信息，也不以讨论要求形成一个结论。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “What observation is remembered, which parts are possible explanations, and is further review wanted?” Use only the fictional situation to distinguish described facts, useful language and undecided matters. Participants may disagree or stop without their own experiences, another person’s information or a required conclusion.

title.en: When words help and when they add pressure
title.zh: 语言有帮助或增添压力的情境

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者觉得一个词在私人阅读时有帮助，却不想在小组介绍时使用。另一个人想要快速定义，读者仍可不回答，也可以完全不用这个词。私下有用、向谁说和是否公开应分开决定，不因问卷选项或别人熟悉某种表达就产生解释义务。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader finds a term useful in private reading but does not want it in a group introduction. Someone wants a quick definition, yet the reader may decline or avoid the term entirely. Private usefulness, audience and publicity are separate choices. Questionnaire responses and someone else’s familiarity with a word create no duty to explain.

title.en: A choice you can keep to yourself
title.zh: 可以只留给自己的选择

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“这个词是否对本人有用，与是否想对外使用，是不是两个可以分开的决定？”可以只针对虚构情境，把已描述的事实、可用语言和未决定事项分开。参与者可以不同意或停止，不解释自己的经历、不提供他人信息，也不以讨论要求形成一个结论。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Can finding a word useful and wanting to use it with others remain two separate decisions?” Use only the fictional situation to distinguish described facts, useful language and undecided matters. Participants may disagree or stop without their own experiences, another person’s information or a required conclusion.

title.zh: 不推荐标签，不检验真实性

Discuss fictional readers only or decline, without relationship experience, contact, intimate practice, identity language or disclosure. Five consecutive four-statement groups follow each item’s current or looking-back wording, with no uniform fixed recall period. Responses are 1 Does not fit at all, 2 Mostly does not fit, 3 Temporarily uncertain or hard to say, 4 Mostly fits and 5 Fits very well, plus explicit preference not to answer. Numbers mark fit with the statement rather than attraction, frequency, ability or identity certainty. Uncertainty at three concerns that particular description. All 20 need an explicit choice to finish; blank differs from a skip. Each topic retains counts at 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and skip, totaling four. Numeric count includes categories 1–5; uncertain count is the subset at three, not an extra response. Choices 4, 3, 1 and skip therefore mean three numeric responses including one uncertain, plus one skip: four statements. There is no score from adding values, mean, percentage, ranking, clarity grade, closest type or recommended label. If any numeric response exists anywhere, all five topics show distributions and the same general full guides. A wholly skipped topic retains four skips and general guidance without inferred reasons. If all 20 are skipped, no personal topic cards or domain interpretations appear: only general rights, privacy, safety and exit remain. All five public guides remain independently readable. Separate recording establishes no statistical independence or cross-topic inference, and a more-selected category is no more authentic or mature. Reliability, validity, norms, fairness, language equivalence and meaningful-change thresholds remain unestablished for the original form, grouping and working English. APA background principles about respecting personal language and avoiding imposed labels validate or endorse none of these items. The page cannot determine, prove, change or suppress orientation, decide identity change or stability from a record, or infer a target gender. Discussion may retain unknowns, disagreement or stop, without answers, private messages or defense of an identity. Responses and records stay in current-page memory without drafts, final-result caches, item uploads, analytics or personal-result sharing. Reloading, changing language, leaving, history restoration and retaking follow existing clearing behavior. That promise erases no browser history and prevents no screen observation, operating-system capture or screenshots. Leave if a device or situation is unsuitable, without completing an observation or explaining.

title.en: An example of keeping control of information
title.zh: 保留信息控制权的例子

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者只想了解“尊重隐私的支持”可能包含什么，不准备联系任何人或透露个人话题。他可以考虑不催问标签、不转发信息等条件，也可以不继续思考。列出这些条件不验证任何具体对象可靠；不需要提供姓名、展示空间或用披露换取支持。
paragraphs.en: An additional original scene: A fictional reader only wants to consider what privacy-respecting support might involve, without contacting anyone or sharing a personal topic. They may consider no pressure for labels and no forwarding of information, or stop thinking about it. Listing conditions verifies no specific person’s trustworthiness and requires no names, private spaces or disclosure in exchange for support.

title.en: An optional consideration, without a disclosure task
title.zh: 可选的考虑，不设置公开任务

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“想要的支持应尊重哪些边界，哪些现实条件本页仍无法核实？”可以只针对虚构情境，把已描述的事实、可用语言和未决定事项分开。参与者可以不同意或停止，不解释自己的经历、不提供他人信息，也不以讨论要求形成一个结论。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Which boundaries should desired support respect, and which real conditions cannot be verified here?” Use only the fictional situation to distinguish described facts, useful language and undecided matters. Participants may disagree or stop without their own experiences, another person’s information or a required conclusion.

title.en: What the page protects and what it cannot promise
title.zh: 页面实际处理范围与不能承诺之处
